title: Weekly well-being check (demo placeholder)
notice: This is a non-clinical placeholder used to demonstrate deterministic scoring and the support pathway. Replace it with an approved, validated instrument only after reviewing version, translation and usage rights.

items.text: How often have you been able to rest when you had the chance?
How often have you felt able to enjoy small moments?
How often have you felt worried or on edge?
How supported have you felt by the people around you?
Have thoughts of harming yourself come to mind?

bands.label: Demo band: lower
bands.followUp: Thank you for checking in. Keep doing the small things that help, and check in again next week.

bands.label: Demo band: middle
bands.followUp: Some things sound hard right now. Consider talking with your doctor, midwife or someone you trust this week.

bands.label: Demo band: higher
bands.followUp: It sounds like a lot is weighing on you. Please talk with your doctor or midwife soon. Support helps, and you deserve it.

bandNote: Demo bands are not clinical cut-offs.
